_comment: D562: what opens a locked way inside a location. Each gate is a LockedDoor (Objects/LockedDoor.tscn, gate_id = the key here) and opens with exactly one of: "key" — an item from the inventory (consumed when "consumes_key"), the opened gate stays open (room_state opened_<node name>, in the save); "flag" — a quest flag an NPC talk sets, the gate is open while the flag holds (quest flags are in the save). "locked_dialogue" — the hero's line when he tries a closed gate (dialogue_quest/<id>.dqd, a KUSAKAM monologue in a bubble). A gate can also stand on a RoomDoor (gate_id), a door off the main road that bars would block: a flag gate (D643) or a key gate (D723: opened for good like a LockedDoor, and open in a save that has already been behind it). Checked by verify_gates.gd and verify_rooms_batch1.gd.
